construction_notes.text: From the state Housing Element Annual Progress Report, through 2025.
12 below-market units, ground-floor commercial; Town list status Complete. A later 20-unit proposal expired.

Letter of justification: project named Park Place, at the southeast corner of Montebello Way and S. Santa Cruz; demolition of the 12,444 sq ft post office building (occupied by USPS since 1967) on a 35,914 sq ft C-2 site; seven-level luxury condominium project over ground-floor commercial space and parking, eight stories total; 233,373 sq ft total building area including garage; 105 ft to top of elevator tower; 61 units per acre; commercial space is also a condominium unit. Redesign removed basement parking, raising the building from seven to eight stories.

Letter of justification unit layout: five stacked residential levels, each with one studio, one 1-bedroom, four 2-bedroom and five 3-bedroom units; three penthouse units on the roof level with a community room, fitness area and roof deck.

Town pending projects page: Architecture and Site S-23-040, Conditional Use Permit U-23-016, Subdivision M-23-008; mixed-use development with 58 multi-family units, ground-floor commercial and a condominium tentative map under SB 330 on C-2 property, APN 529-01-022; CEQA review pending; planner Erin Walters; status Pending.

Town SB 330 list: Post Office Proposal 1, 58 units, 12 (21%) below market, 8 stories, vested to 6/7/2023, completeness Complete, status Pending, invokes Builder's Remedy. Proposal 2: 20 units, 4 (20%) below market, 4 stories, Expired.
Los Gatan (Aug. 10, 2023): CSM Investments, LLC revealed plans on June 2, 2023 for a five-story, 72-condo mixed-use building with 20% lower-income units under the Builder's Remedy.
State report 2023, application stage: density bonus requested; 12 low-income and 46 above-moderate units.
